name: apartment_report
query:
SELECT

    a.apartment_name AS "Apartment:Data:180",
    a.place AS "Place:Data:150",
    a.address AS "Address:Data:220",

    an.message AS "Announcement:Data:300",
    an.from_date AS "From:Datetime:160",
    an.to_date AS "To:Datetime:160"

FROM `tabapartment_details` a

LEFT JOIN `tabannouncement` an
ON an.parent=a.name

ORDER BY
a.apartment_name;
